label: An unmapped request, answered by the mock
description: The mock profile does not model requests the tool could not map to an operation. It answers every one of them with this fixed body, so a tester can see what sending one looks like without a network.
basis: Synthetic. This is not a response from any service.

response.note: The mock profile does not model unmapped requests. On the live profile this request is sent as written, and this is where the answer of the service would be.
